title: Eye Explorer Lab
objectives: Name the main parts of the eye and their jobs
Trace how the eye forms an image
Explain the iris, retina and blind spot

stages.title: Journey Into the Eye
stages.narration: Shrink down and explore the greatest light-detector ever made — your own eye!

steps.text: Shard 7 rests inside a giant model eye.
Ray Bot shrinks you down to explore it.
A beam of light enters the cornea beside you…

stages.title: Meet the Parts of the Eye
stages.prompt: Tap each part to learn its job. Visit them all!

locations.label: Cornea
locations.info: The clear front window where light first enters the eye.

locations.label: Iris
locations.info: The coloured ring that changes the pupil's size to control light.

locations.label: Pupil
locations.info: The black opening that lets light pass into the eye.

locations.label: Lens
locations.info: Focuses the light to form a sharp image on the retina.

locations.label: Retina
locations.info: The light-sensitive screen at the back where the image forms.

locations.label: Optic Nerve
locations.info: Carries the picture signal from the retina to the brain.

stages.title: Which Part Does the Job?
stages.prompt: Match each job to the correct part of the eye.

tasks.label: Controls how much light enters
tasks.explain: The iris changes the pupil size to control light.

tasks.label: Focuses light to a sharp image
tasks.explain: The lens focuses light onto the retina.

tasks.label: The screen where the image forms
tasks.explain: The image forms on the retina, then travels to the brain.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Focus the Light
stages.prompt: Score 80% to focus a perfect image and claim shard 7!

questions.q: The image on the retina is…
options: upside down, then fixed by the brain
questions.explain: The lens forms an inverted image; the brain flips it upright.
The iris shrinks the pupil to let in less light when it's bright.
Where the optic nerve leaves, there are no light cells, so no image forms.

questions.q: Colour is detected by which cells?
questions.explain: Cones detect colour in bright light; rods work in dim light.

questions.q: Persistence of vision lets us enjoy…
questions.explain: The retina holds each frame briefly, so rapid stills look like motion.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 7 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Vision Voyager badge
One shard left — Umbra makes his final stand!
